title: Cheats
summary: Give gold, troops and items, or fix what a cheater broke.

sections.heading: Before you start
steps: Cheats work while the server is running and says Server online.
Coodsz Coop Server Tool adds its own server tools on every Start. Players do not need them.

sections.heading: Using the Cheats page
steps: Pick a player on the left, or tick the boxes to pick several.
Pick a tab. Gold, Health, Army, Clan, Character or Items and compensation.
Type an amount and press the button. A change only counts when the server confirms it.
To send your own console command, use the Console page.

sections.heading: Undo and the Admin log
steps: Every change goes into the Admin log with the old and the new value.
Press Undo next to a recent change to put it back.

sections.heading: Pictures
steps: Press Build pictures to draw item and troop pictures with your own game.
It starts Bannerlord once and closes it when it is done. Until then the cards show names.
sections.tip: Client cheats on Settings is something else. It lets players use cheats themselves.
